QuestInfo.name: Hunting Lessons 2
QuestInfo.0: You finished your first hunt, but you're quite concerned that Moonbeam is going to make you eat a #o2400200#. You're not a picky eater, but bugs are just not your kind of cuisine. Maybe you should let her know.
QuestInfo.1: Moonbeam pulled the legs and antennae off the #o2400200# and started eating. You couldn't manage a good excuse why you didn't want any, so now she wants you to get some #o2400201#s. A #o2400201#? is that any different from a #o2400200#?
QuestInfo.2: You don't think you can eat this either. All this bug meat is making you nauseous. Where's a nice, hot sandwich when you need one?

0.0: Hey, not bad! I was worried you were too spongy to be any good at hunting. But you're a natural! I'll tell you a secret... Lumps almost starved because it took him a week to catch his first prey. A week! I, of course, succeeded on my first try.
0.1: All right, tasting time! You just break off the legs like so, the antennae like so, and voila! Here, eat this. Mmmm, crunchy AND savory.
0.2: Why aren't you eating? You picky about your grub? Oh, or was it the crack about kits eating these? Well, whatever. You need to step up your hunting anyway, so let's get you some fine cuisine.

yes.0: Let's try #o2400201#s this time. They're kind of annoying because they fly around, but the meat is fantastic. My favorite meal! You're pretty big, so maybe like #r15 #t4009220##k will do.

no.0: No? Then eat it! I'm just gonna stuff it in your face!

1.0: How goes the hunt? I hope you didn't come back empty-handed!

default.0: You can't call yourself a Pointy-Ear Fox if you can't even hunt stupid caterpillars!
